summary_md: **ALGOIT | AI News & How-Tos ([@ai_algoit](https://x.com/ai_algoit/status/2115775712867373525))** reports NVIDIA's **Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe**, an open-weight 30B MoE (~4B active) speech model for up to hour-long recordings in 40 languages with speaker labels and translation, available on Hugging Face and described as commercially usable ([nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B)).
relevance: A ~30B-class local speech model that fits a DGX Spark.
